title: Validate before you scale
purpose: Ship the top 1–2 opportunity bets as scoped experiments. A/B on the segment/category where the friction concentrates, not platform-wide.
north_star: Wishlist → purchase conversion within 30 days (item-level, same grain as Phase 1).
output: Experiment brief per bet: hypothesis, cell, treatment, primary, guardrails, stop/scale. Empty until Phase 3 ranks.
status_note: No experiment rows until Phase 3 fills the map and Phase 4 binds a non-monetary treatment to a cell. Do not invent lift. Do not A/B coupons.

primary_metric.name: wishlist_to_purchase_30d
primary_metric.definition: Share of wishlisted items purchased on Myntra within 30 days of add (or of treatment exposure — declare which).

guardrails.label: Return rate
guardrails.why: Fit-related fixes can raise or lower returns. A conversion win that inflates returns is not a win.

guardrails.label: Time-to-first-purchase
guardrails.why: Resurfacing / occasion reminders can pull purchases forward without adding them. Track p50 / p90.

rules: A/B in the concentrating cell (category × tenure × wishlist-size), not all wishlist users.
One or two bets. A third is usually a failure to prioritize.
Scale only if primary lifts, guardrails hold, and it is not a day-31 pull-forward.
Do not roll out everywhere because it did not hurt.
